notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes: [p]The [i][b]Portal to Nowhere[/b][/i][b] playtest is finally available to everyone![/b] You can now join the test and play through all four acts of the game (except for the finale).[/p][list][*][p]If you're launching the game for the first time, [b]please pay attention to the disclaimer shown at startup[/b]. It briefly explains the current state of the build: final art and sound are still in development, and texts are being refined. There are also contact links for reporting bugs, typos, and general feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]The goal of this playtest is to identify any non-intuitive (aka "moonlogic") puzzles and ensure that the game functions as intended. Any feedback will be a huge help in bringing the project to completion.[/p][/*][*][p]If you enjoyed what you played - [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b]. It really makes a difference and helps the project grow.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the game![/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes: [list][*][p]The main work on the cutscenes in [i]Portal to Nowhere[/i] is nearly finished. What’s left is a final editing pass with the help of a friend to make sure all the text reads smoothly and is free of typos.[/p][/*][*][p]After that, I’m planning to run an [b]open playtest[/b], tentatively in [b]1-2 weeks[/b]. It’ll be a great chance to gather feedback, catch bugs, and see which scenes or puzzles work as intended - and which ones need a bit more polish.[/p][/*][*][p]I'm also thinking of adding some [b]sound effects[/b] - right now, the game is almost silent, and that definitely hurts the atmosphere. If I have time, I’ll try to add at least some basic audio before the playtest to bring things to life a bit.[/p][/*][*][p]Finally, I’ll be opening a [b]permanent Q&A thread[/b] in the Community Hub soon, where you’ll be able to ask anything about the development process.[/p][/*][/list]
